correctness.rationale: Binary addition for n+jd, j=0,...,4, produces bounded carries and exact parity updates for 11-block counts. All 864 reachable NFA states are enumerated; an exhaustive least fixed point computes achievable terminal relative parity signatures under arbitrary high n bits once d has ended. All 1302 determinized states satisfy the output-mask invariant with 2,13,1287 states in digit-popcount classes 0,1,2+, with every transition checked, so the relative spectra 0xff96 for powers of two and 0xffff otherwise hold for every positive difference. Adding the separated high block 11 complements all five absolute symbols, giving two words for every relative signature. Direct prefix enumeration for differences 1..128 is a secondary sanity check only.

originality.rationale: The final theorem fixes the common difference universally and determines the support of every five-bit word. The primary correlation paper (Jugé–Marcovici 2022) treats limiting frequencies and correlation order across arbitrary offset tuples, and the closest same-word prescribed-step paper (Sobolewski 2022) treats only maximal monochromatic run lengths, not individual nonconstant patterns. The broader arithmetical subword-complexity paper allows the difference to vary and cannot imply a statement for every fixed difference. Actual exact-pattern and alias searches and relevant own-ledger comparisons found no covering claim. The decisive residual risk is an unindexed equivalent calculation or an implicit consequence in another full treatment.
residual_risks: An unindexed older calculation in the large Rudin–Shapiro/correlation literature might already derive the same five-tuple support masks.
The 62-page general Gowers-norm paper was inspected for its stated main results rather than every technical lemma; a specialized implicit implication remains a small risk.
The final theorem is only a support classification; it does not provide exact limiting frequencies or results for six or more sampled positions.

value.rationale: The two-parameter question (prescribed common difference and complete five-letter pattern support) naturally refines the foundational study of correlations and monochromatic progressions for the Rudin–Shapiro automatic word. The exact 24-versus-32 dichotomy and eight explicit excluded words identify a sharp binary-popcount phase transition, while the symbolic finite-state invariant explains the arithmetic obstruction and supplies a reusable exact mechanism. This is not a routine relabeling or a small finite table; it is a uniform infinite classification at a natural five-term boundary.
